report_write.receipt: The user authorized one-shot Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 isolation plus maintainability review on 2026-08-20

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Direction, Coefficient, and Scale stages have separate public transactions and stage-owned configuration; the serial route only composes them.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Exact APIs require Stage 2 and Stage 3 to consume predecessor artifact paths, and typed results expose stage, path, digest, parent digest, and gate metrics.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Scripts remain composition roots; schema interpretation, digest binding, gate validation, loss, and owner construction stay in fada_context.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: One discriminated v2 envelope, parent digests, unique temporary files, finally cleanup, old-target preservation, and fail-closed predecessor loading close the transaction lifecycle.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The plan changes only calibration training ownership, its four training CLIs, focused tests, and identity-bound evidence documents.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: TDD, impacted Module Alignment, maintainability final gate, formal runtime, simulator execution, and policy quality remain separate evidence layers.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: The plan covers RED/GREEN owner cases, invalid order and identity, persistence rollback, serial fresh reload, parsers, affected regression, lint, typing, module evidence, and final review.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Stage artifacts bind Contracts, H/K/D, architecture, axis order, dataset/split/source identities, gate metrics, parent digests, and exact Scale Evidence bytes.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: DirectionStageConfig reaches only the Direction Bank transaction, CoefficientStageConfig reaches only the Encoder transaction, and Stage 3 cannot construct an optimizer.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: The plan retires the old public stage writer/loader, rejects v1, requires strict predecessor fresh reload, and preserves the existing final deployment artifact as the sole runtime input.

residual_risks: READY authorizes bounded offline construction only and does not establish formal-route connectivity, simulator behavior, learning efficacy, policy quality, or server readiness.
